units.source_text: 你对夫人如此冷酷无情，叫我们旁人看了也愤愤不平。”

en.t: You are so cold and heartless toward your wife that even we bystanders feel indignant when we see it."

units.source_text: 说时以袖掩口，眼色异常俊俏。

en.t: As she spoke, she covered her mouth with her sleeve, and the look in her eyes was extraordinarily charming.

units.source_text: 然而髭黑大将心不在此，只怪自己怎么会看中木工君这种女人。

en.t: However, General Higekuro's mind was elsewhere; he only blamed himself for ever having taken an interest in a woman like Mokuno-kimi.
What an ill-fated and heartless person he truly is!
